channel.title: Aryeh Leib Toren — Writing
channel.description: Featured essays by Aryeh Leib Thorne Toren.

item.title: Hear, My People: Psalm 81 and the Blind Father
item.description: Psalm 81, the Thursday psalm, meets Yitzchak in the tent in the week of Toldot: one sense, hearing. A 4-page study.

item.title: The Garments of Esav, the Voice of Yaakov
item.description: Toldot: Yitzchak smells the garments. Bogdav, Rashi on the scent of Gan Eden, and the voice of Yaakov, a 5-page study.

item.title: The Voice and the Hands
item.description: The voice of Yaakov and the hands of Esau: Toldot, Rashi and the Hayom Yom for 2 Kislev, an 8-page essay.

item.title: Not to Another Place
item.description: Iran's uranium, and a Rambam ruling on goods that leave your hand: a 5-page essay.

item.title: Wells, Witnesses and Heirs: An Expanded Edition
item.description: A second, expanded edition of Wells, Witnesses and Heirs: the introduction and Chapter Four, Wells by Their Old Names.

item.title: We Have Surely Seen: Covenant, Memory and Partnership
item.description: A study booklet on the treaty at Beersheba: the introduction and Chapter Three, on what both sides had seen.

item.title: Tehillim 144: Who Trains My Hands
item.description: A study booklet on Tehillim 144: the introduction and Chapter One, on hands that were taught to fight.

item.title: Tehillim 25: To You I Lift My Soul
item.description: A study booklet on Tehillim 25: the introduction and Chapter One, on lifting the soul to G-d.

item.title: Tehillim 1–9: The First Day
item.description: A study booklet on the first nine psalms: the introduction and Chapter One, on Tehillim 1.

item.title: Tehillim 94: The Song of the Fourth Day
item.description: A study booklet on Tehillim 94: the introduction and Chapter Seven, on a throne that frames mischief by statute.

item.title: What Is Chanukah? A Kislev Study Booklet
item.description: A study booklet on Kislev: the introduction and the Gemara's question, What is Chanukah?

item.title: Kislev as the Architecture of Completion (X Article)
item.description: Light, bitachon, progressive actualization, and the Nesi'im. The shortened X Article posted on 11 November 2026.

item.title: Kislev as the Architecture of Completion
item.description: Light, bitachon, the lights added night by night, and the reading of the Nesi'im: how Kislev turns potential into actual and darkness into light.

item.title: The Vessel and the Witness: Torah from Bereishis to Sukkos
item.description: A second, fuller edition of The Vessel and the Witness: eight chapters from Bereishis to Sukkos, with maamarim, sichos, and sources for study.

item.title: G-d Stands Among the Judges: A Tehillim 82 Booklet
item.description: A study booklet on Tehillim 82, the psalm of the third day: verse by verse, with the classic commentaries.

item.title: Wells, Psalms and the New Knesset: A 30 Cheshvan Booklet
item.description: A hundred-page study booklet gathering fifty threads from 30 Cheshvan 5787: the wells of Toldot, the morning psalms, and a new Knesset finding its feet.

item.title: Seven Days, Twenty-Eight Days, and the Number 61: The Road from the Ballot to a Government
item.description: The ballots have been counted. The next part of Israeli democracy happens in quiet rooms rather than at voting stations.

item.title: Nothing Has Happened Yet
item.description: Two notes from Rashi on Toldot, five verses apart: the quiet stretch made Yitzchak careless, the hard year made him work. Guard anyway, plant anyway.

item.title: The Life That Continues: Sarah’s Particular Dominion, the Name of the Parsha, and Covenantal Non-Domination
item.description: Why is a parsha that opens with Sarah's death called the life of Sarah? Likkutei Sichos 15, Chayei Sarah A: true life is enduring influence, and Sarah's serarah guards the inheritance. With Pettit, Skinner, Nelson and Elazar.

item.title: Clear Title as Covenantal Acquisition: Rambam’s Hilchot Zechiyah uMattanah, Chapters 4–6 (3 November 2026 / 23 Cheshvan 5787), and the Demand for Public, Intent-Aligned Ownership in Torah and Republican Thought
item.description: The daily Rambam for 3 November 2026, Hilchot Zechiyah uMattanah 4 to 6: a transfer holds when it is final, public and aligned with true intent. Read beside Machpelah, Locke, Pettit, Demsetz and North.
